purpose: Cover AC-15503-1 (rcf feedback defer appends a deferredUntilSession state line per pending entry stamped with the current sessionId) and AC-15503-2 (rcf feedback discard marks only named entries or every pending under --all, hides them from list default, and refuses on an unknown id).
title: Slice 1 (FBS-180): rcf feedback defer and rcf feedback discard honour the fold-by-id state transitions and refuse on unknown ids

testCases.description: Cover AC-15503-1 via the CLI test: defer appends one deferredUntilSession state line per pending entry, stamped with the current sessionId; the folded read reports both entries at status deferredUntilSession; no network call.
testCases.testPointer: test/cli/feedback-defer-discard.test.js::AC-15503-1: defer appends a deferredUntilSession state line per pending entry

testCases.description: Cover AC-15503-2 (named ids) via the CLI test: discard <id1> <id2> marks those entries discarded, list default hides them, --all shows their status.
testCases.testPointer: test/cli/feedback-defer-discard.test.js::AC-15503-2: discard <id> marks only named entries and hides them from list default

testCases.description: Cover AC-15503-2 (--all arm) via the CLI test: discard --all marks every pending entry discarded and list default is empty.
testCases.testPointer: test/cli/feedback-defer-discard.test.js::AC-15503-2: discard --all marks every pending entry discarded

testCases.description: Cover AC-15503-2 (unknown-id arm) via the CLI test: discard on an unknown id exits 2, no state line is written to the log.
testCases.testPointer: test/cli/feedback-defer-discard.test.js::AC-15503-2: discard with an unknown id exits 2 and writes nothing
